facts.fact: This Rask AI blog post, published 21 Aug 2024, is the page's stated publication date.
According to this Rask AI blog post, HeyGen offers four pricing plans upon registration.
facts.quote: Upon registration, choose a pricing plan – one of four options.

facts.fact: According to this page, HeyGen's free plan allows up to 3 videos per month, each lasting up to 3 minutes.
facts.quote: Each month, you can craft up to 3 videos, each lasting up to 3 minutes.

facts.fact: According to this page, HeyGen's free plan allows up to 60 studio avatars and one custom avatar.
facts.quote: Use up to 60 studio avatars and only one custom avatar

facts.fact: According to this page, all videos exported on HeyGen's free plan carry a watermark.
facts.quote: Note that all videos are exported with a watermark.

facts.fact: According to this page, HeyGen's Creator plan costs $29 per month.
According to this page, HeyGen's Creator plan allows videos up to 5 minutes long and up to 3 instant avatars.
facts.quote: The video duration here is 5 minutes, and you are not limited to the number of videos.

facts.fact: According to this page, HeyGen's Team plan costs $89 per month.
According to this page, HeyGen's Team plan allows videos up to 60 minutes long.
facts.quote: Craft unlimited videos with a 60-minute duration.

facts.fact: According to this page, HeyGen does not offer a free trial; the free plan is used instead.
facts.quote: Note that a free trial is absent

facts.fact: According to this page, HeyGen offers 300 avatars made by HeyGen.
facts.quote: Choose one of 300 avatars made by HeyGen.

facts.fact: According to this page, HeyGen operates in more than 200 languages.
According to this page, HeyGen has a 4.7-star rating on Trustpilot.
facts.quote: HeyGen has 4.7 stars on Trustpilot – that's quite a good status.

facts.fact: According to this page, customer support for HeyGen can take up to several days to respond to an email.
facts.quote: It takes up to several days to receive an email response.
